construct: align-items / justify-content authored on a container whose display is NOT flex (here display: table)
why: enrichLayout is the only producer of a Part.layout axis in the whole pipeline, and it declined every non-flex container with a bare `continue` — no receipt of any kind, on the base combo's display alone. That silence is why a forward layout failure could never be cited: the fact arrived, nothing carried it, and nothing said so. The decline is correct (a table box has no flex axis and the contract has no spelling for one); being silent about it was not.

canvas.note: auto-layout has no table formatting context; the axis is code-only and named
